verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a Management API, CLI, and MCP server that let AI agents create projects, run migrations, deploy functions, query the database, etc. (supabase-docs-5, supabase-docs-28, supabase-probe-3, supabase-probe-4), which covers most UI functionality programmatically. However, several dashboard-only features (Table Editor, Advisors, AI Assistant, Logs UI) aren't clearly mirrored 1:1 via API/CLI, and community feedback notes the dashboard still encourages manual, non-API-driven database edits that the CEO himself discourages (supabase-comm-6, supabase-comm-7), showing incomplete parity in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming full API/CLI equivalence for every dashboard feature (e.g., Advisors, Logs, Table Editor actions) and independent confirmation that no UI-only capability exists.
